claims: 10 is the even natural number following 9 and preceding 11.
10 is the base of the decimal numeral system.
10 was historically considered a symbol of perfection or completeness.
The 1979 film "10" follows a songwriter who rates women on a scale of 1 to 10.
The 2022 film titled 10 is about a boxer overcoming drug allegations.
